correctness.rationale: The ten regular differentials give the complete nine-entry Cartier coefficient matrix. For \(u^2\ne4\) the matrix has rank seven, hence \(a=3\). The Frobenius-semilinear cycle contraction is \(Q(u)\), and the relevant \(7^4\)th power of its four-step coefficient is \((4-u^2)^{343}Q(u)\); all remaining paths die under iteration. Stable rank is therefore zero precisely at \(Q(u)=0\) and four otherwise. The polynomial is squarefree, coprime to \(u^2-4\), and has irreducible factor degrees \(3,3,4,6\). Both packaged exact checkers were executed at the actual paths, including arithmetic over a degree-six extension. The universal result follows from polynomial identities, not extrapolation from finite cases.
